start: A member who joined a gym with the leaderboard on, online

steps.action: Open Settings; in 'Your gym' tap 'What my gym can see' (sub 'Your name on the leaderboard')
user_sees: Title 'What my gym can see'
'Your gym's staff see how many workouts you did and how much weight you lifted each day, with your name...'
Switch 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard', off
must_not: The switch on before the member turned it on

steps.action: Turn on 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard'
user_sees: The switch on
Back on Settings the row sub reads 'Your name shows on the leaderboard'
must_not: The change lost when the internet is off: it must be kept and sent later

user_sees: The member's first name and the first letter of the last name
must_not: The full last name or phone number shown to other members
'A member' still shown after the gym has heard the change

start: What my gym can see, the gym server holds shared workouts

steps.action: Turn on 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' with the name switch off
user_sees: The switch on
'Gym mates can open your workouts only while 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' is on.'
must_not: Gym mates able to open the workouts while the name switch is off

steps.action: Turn on the name switch too
user_sees: Gym mates can tap the name to see the bio and up to 30 workouts from the last 60 days
must_not: Photos, body weight, notes or the phone number shared

start: What my gym can see, the gym has Busy machines on

user_sees: 'If your gym turns on Busy machines, the app sends which of the gym's machines you used, and the day and hour. Your gym sees only totals, never your name.'
Switch 'Share which machines I use', on
must_not: The old intro 'MettleUp never sends which exercises you did' shown while machines are shared

steps.action: Turn 'Share which machines I use' off and do a workout
user_sees: 'Off: the app sends nothing about the machines you use.'
must_not: Machine use sent after the switch is off

start: What my gym can see, the gym server has the trainer view and the owner picked a trainer

user_sees: Switch 'Share my workouts with my trainers', on
'Your trainer: <first name>'
Button 'Ask my trainer for help' (or 'Ask a trainer' on newer gym servers)
must_not: A trainer card on a gym server without the trainer view

user_sees: 'Sent. Your trainer will get in touch.'
must_not: Two requests from a double tap

start: Settings, a member in a gym with a logo, on Android

steps.action: Tap 'Gym logo on my home screen' (sub 'Opens MettleUp from your home screen')
user_sees: The phone's add-to-home-screen question, then a line saying it was added
must_not: Another gym's logo
A second shortcut from a double tap

steps.action: Tap 'Leave <gym name>' (sub 'Your workouts stay on this phone. Your leaderboard numbers are removed from the gym.')
user_sees: A question before leaving
must_not: Leaving with no question

start: What my gym can see, the gym's leaderboard not answered yet (gym leaderboard off, or offline)

steps.action: Open the page by a What's new 'What my gym can see' button
user_sees: 'Your gym's leaderboard is not switched on yet.'
must_not: Switches that seem to work but are never sent

steps.action: Open the Your gym page or What my gym can see by an old link
user_sees: The Gym tab's 'Join your gym' screen
must_not: An empty Your gym page
Another gym's name

start: What my gym can see with the internet off

user_sees: 'Could not send. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: 'Sent' shown for a request that failed

start: What my gym can see, sharing on

steps.action: Turn off 'Let my gym mates see my workouts'
user_sees: The switch off
must_not: The shared workouts still on the gym after the gym has heard the change

steps.action: Turn off 'Share my workouts with my trainers'
user_sees: The switch off; no 'Ask my trainer for help'
must_not: The weekly summary still with the gym

steps.action: Leave the gym from Settings, confirm
user_sees: Settings 'Your gym' shows 'Join your gym'
must_not: Leaderboard numbers, trainer summary, machine use or shared workouts kept at the gym

start: A member in a gym with every gym feature on

steps.action: Read every caption on What my gym can see
user_sees: What staff see (workouts and kg per day, with the name), what members see ('A member' unless the name is on), what trainers see (weekly summary or workouts since joining, up to 12 months), and that body weight, photos and notes are never sent
must_not: Anything sent that a caption says is never sent
The trainer view switch on by default with no caption saying so

steps.action: Look at the gym panel as staff
user_sees: Only the data the captions name
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes in the panel
